input.title: [Mobile] Red banner on device status bar remains after user tap X button on the alert on iOS 26
input.body: ## Step to reproduce 1. Create 2 thoughts: Aaaa and Bbbb 2. Move Bbbb into subthougt of Aaaa 3. Tap Home button to clear all thought from focus 4. Verify that Bbbb is hidden 5. Tap Hamburger button 6. Select Recently Edited 7. Tap Bbbb under Home icon (NOT under Aaaa) 8. Tap Delete button from toolbar 9. Verify "Permanently deleted Bbbb" alert is shown. 10. Tap the Delete button again 11. Tap X button on the read banner alert ## Current behavior Red banner on device status remains. This is iOS 26 specific issue Related to #3609 **Video:** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/112b5b58-31be-484b-9c63-09a4551de5cc ## Expected behavior Red banner should be dismissed after user taps X button
